title: While My Guitar Gently Weeps
hook: Why do these chords sound like *slow tears*?
cover_text: A bass line that *falls like tears*
question: Which chord gave it away for you? 👇

chords.name: Am/G
chords.text: The bass *drops to G*. Something gives.

chords.name: Am/F#
chords.text: *F♯ in the bass*: a bittersweet ache.

chords.name: F
chords.text: E slips to F: *the fall lands softly*.

chords.name: D
chords.text: *D major*: F♯, a glimmer of light.

chords.name: E
chords.text: E pulls home. *The tears keep falling*.
